questions.question: What did Solomon ask God for in a dream?
How did Solomon famously judge between two women claiming one baby?
options: He cast lots to decide the matter
He gave the child to the elder woman
He offered to cut the baby in two
questions.answer: He offered to cut the baby in two

questions.question: God was pleased that Solomon asked for wisdom, and gave him riches too.
